scholarships.title: DTU Tuition Fee Waiver for International non-EU/EEA MSc Students

existing.funding_period: per academic year for two years
existing.description: DTU awards a very limited number of tuition fee waivers to new international non-EU/EEA MSc students applying for the autumn intake, allocating them to students with excellent academic performance. A waiver covers the tuition fee for two years. To be considered, applicants must apply by the 15 January deadline and submit a separate personal statement with the application that focuses on academic achievements at bachelor's level; applications without that statement are not considered. Waivers are offered only for the autumn intake, are decided in parallel with admissions, and are granted after the applicant accepts an admission offer.
eligibility: Citizen of a country outside the EU and EEA applying to a DTU MSc programme
Applying for the autumn intake; waivers are not offered for the spring intake
New student, i.e. not a continuing student
Submitting a separate personal statement with the application that clearly specifies the waiver application
Submitting the application and paying the application fee by the 15 January deadline
Non-EU/EEA applicants with a qualifying degree obtained in Denmark must also apply by 15 January
existing.eligibility_summary: New international non-EU/EEA applicants to a DTU two-year MSc programme for the autumn intake who have excellent academic performance and who submit a separate personal statement for the waiver with their application by the 15 January deadline.
benefits: Tuition fee waiver covering the tuition fee for two years
Decided in parallel with the admissions process
Granted after accepting an offer of admission
requirements: Submit the application by 15 January and pay the application fee
Include a separate personal statement for the waiver; without it the application is not considered
Meet all admission requirements for the chosen MSc programme
Accept the offer of admission to receive the waiver
documents: Completed MSc application submitted by the 15 January deadline
Separate personal statement for the tuition fee waiver focusing on academic achievements at bachelor's level
Language test results meeting DTU's requirements
existing.english_requirement: Non-EU applicants must fulfil and submit language test requirements by the 15 January application deadline
application_method: Apply for the MSc programme in the autumn round and submit a separate personal statement with the same application, clearly specifying that it is for the tuition fee waiver
existing.selection_notes: Selection runs in parallel with admissions. Applicants are assessed on their grades (GPA or equivalent), the ranking of the university that awarded their bachelor's degree, and extracurricular research experience or publications, relevant work or teaching experience, competition awards and extracurricular activities.
existing.best_fit: Top non-EU engineering and science master's students at DTU
existing.notes: DTU does not publish a programme named 'DTU Excellence Scholarship'; the merit tuition fee waiver described here is the award that matches the substance of the stored row, including its 15 January deadline. The stored official_source_url points to a separate page titled 'National Scholarships for DTU', which lists external, country-specific scholarships (Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, India, Indonesia, Kazakhstan, Mexico, Turkey, USA) and does not document this award.
existing.duration: A tuition fee waiver will cover the tuition fee for two years
existing.application_period: Please note that your application will not be processed until the application fee payment has been registered at DTU.
existing.deadline_display: "All non-EU/EEA students who apply by the 15 January deadline and who wish to apply for a tuition fee waiver must submit a separate personal statement with the application, clearly specifying that you are applying for the tuition fee waiver." DTU's important dates page for the autumn intake gives '15 January Application deadline - Non-EU' and 'April Tuition fee waivers announced - Non-EU'.
existing.program_type: Merit-based tuition fee waiver awarded with admission
